checks.source_evidence: it remains to be seen how accurately these explanations actually represent the reasons behind model predictions—that is, how faithful the explanations are (Jacovi and Goldberg, 2020).
checks.citing_evidence: Whether the CoT faithfully reflects the model’s underlying computation has become a core question in alignment research (Turpin et al., 2023; Lanham et al., 2023). Conceptual steganography is one specific way in which the visible CoT can fail to be a faithful supervisory surface: the model can satisfy the surface task while simultaneously transmitting a covert payload to a co-conspirator who shares its codebook.
